messages:
Rina (design): Quick UX vote 12: on compact dashboards should we reduce secondary/ghost button visual height to 32px so rows and actions align? Also noticed toast notifications sometimes cover inline row actions in the table. Proposal: keep visual 32px but preserve 44px touch area; make non-interactive toasts sit above toolbar but below modal overlay. Thoughts? :eyes:

Omar (frontend): I like the alignment. Implementation: keep height:32px, add invisible padding via ::before to hit 44px. Minimal DOM changes. Concern: z-indexs. Can we standardize z vars?

Tess (a11y): Invisible hit area ok if keyboard focus still lands on the button and touch target >=44px. For toasts: aria-live=\"polite\" + role=\"status\" and do not move focus. Non-interactive toasts should not be focusable.

Kai (devex): Suggested z vars: --z-toolbar:700, --z-toast:800, --z-modal-overlay:1000. Default toasts pointer-events:none; interactive variant pointer-events:auto + tabindex=0. I'll add token aliases for compact spacing if we rename them to avoid breaking consumers.

Omar (frontend): Snippet to add:
```css
.btn-compact { position: relative; height: 32px; }
.btn-compact::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left:0; right:0; top:-6px; bottom:-6px; }
.toast { z-index: var(--z-toast,800); pointer-events: none; }
```

Rina (design): Copy nit: change empty-state CTA from \"Try again\" to \"Retry\" to keep console terse. Also agree on aliasing tokens for one release. Can we canary in staging?

Kai (devex): Yep will open a small PR with token aliases + toast z var + compact button patch and add a visual test for dense table + action strip. Draft PR link in thread when ready.

Tess (a11y): Checklist for PR: maintain 44px hit area, toasts use role/status + aria-live, interactive toasts must be reachable by keyboard and not steal focus, ensure Escape still closes modals. I'll review on staging.

Rina (design): Great. One design + one a11y review before merge. Thanks :rocket:
